flagHelp.--setting-sources: --setting-sources <sources> Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local).
flagHelp.--resume: --resume <session-id>, continues that session in the background under the same ID, or starts a copy and says so when the session is already running
flagHelp.--fork-session: --fork-session When resuming, create a new session ID instead of reusing the original (use with --resume or --continue)
flagHelp.--input-format: --input-format <format> Input format (only works with --print): "text" (default), or "stream-json" (realtime streaming input) (choices: "text", "stream-json")
flagHelp.--include-partial-messages: --include-partial-messages Include partial message chunks as they arrive (only works with --print and --output-format=stream-json)
flagHelp.--replay-user-messages: --replay-user-messages Re-emit user messages from stdin back on stdout for acknowledgment (only works with --input-format=stream-json and --output-format=stream-json)
flagHelp.--verbose: --verbose Override verbose mode setting from config
flagHelp.--mcp-config: --mcp-config <configs...> Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated)
flagHelp.--strict-mcp-config: --strict-mcp-config Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations
flagHelp.--no-session-persistence: --no-session-persistence Disable session persistence - sessions will not be saved to disk and cannot be resumed (only works with --print)
